values.meaning: seconds Jax remains in Evasion before it automatically recasts if not recast sooner
seconds after casting before Counter Strike can be manually recast
values.quote: can be recast after 1 second, and does so automatically after the duration.
values.binNote: The wiki states this 1s minimum recast delay separately from the on-hit stun duration on the recast. The sheet's only data value of 1 for this ability is JaxE.StunDuration, which by name matches the recast's stun instead; it is not clear whether the same field also gates this minimum recast delay or whether that delay is simply not exposed as a data value here, so it is not cited as the source.

values.meaning: damage increase to the recast, per basic attack (or on-hit-triggering ability) dodged during Evasion
values.quote: increased by 20% for each attack dodged

values.meaning: maximum number of dodges counted toward the recast's damage increase (each worth 20%, capping the increase at 100%)

mechanics.claim: Counter Strike's cooldown starts only once its effect resolves (after the recast), not at the moment it is initially cast.
Both the initial cast and the recast of Counter Strike each count as a separate ability activation, e.g. for on-cast item effects like Spellblade.
mechanics.quote: The initial cast and the manual recast count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.

mechanics.claim: The recast's bonus damage scales only with attacks or on-hit-triggering abilities Jax actually dodged during Evasion; since this simulator's target dummy never attacks, no dodges can ever occur, so Counter Strike always deals its Minimum (undoubled) damage in this fight model.
mechanics.quote: with the '''total''' damage increased by 20% for each attack dodged, up to a 100% increase
